notes.note: queryDefaults.ts delta: added stationMutationDefaults() (networkMode 'always'); query defaults, including the transport_capacity no-retry rule, are unchanged. AccountPreferencesProvider.tsx delta: its save mutation now states networkMode 'online' explicitly, preserving the existing wait-in-memory-while-offline behavior against the new fail-fast app default.

main.tsx delta: only the bootstrap QueryClient's defaults gained stationMutationDefaults(); provider order, boot, theming and share-page mounting are unchanged, so this document's main.tsx claims remain accurate.

Updated the mutation paragraph: offline writes fail fast on the app clients, account preferences opt into waiting, and reconnect keeps a verified observation while re-reading a failed one (also on the health signal). AuthorityQueryContext.tsx delta: the observation retries on reconnect only when failed, a failed non-refused observation exposes reobserve(), and the authority client gained the mutation defaults; isolation, verification and quarantine rules are unchanged.

Collapsed cards still show elapsed time; only its tick source changed. AgentsWorkspacePane.tsx delta: Running rows read useElapsedClock instead of a private 1 s interval. SubagentTranscriptCard.tsx delta: its running clock reads useElapsedClock instead of a private ticker.
